verdict.rationale: The vLLM GitHub README documents building from source for development, so the core build-from-source path exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the build needs only minimal external dependencies, and the documented install path relies on uv/pip with a torch backend. missing for 10: evidence of minimal or self-contained external dependencies, detailed source-build documentation (toolchain, steps, supported platforms), independent or hands-on corroboration of source builds.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build the runtime from source with minimal external dependencies
